title: Kamakshi’s Birthday Vlog ❤️ Shopping, Surprise & Late Night Fun!
description:
Kamakshi’s Birthday Vlog ❤️ Shopping, Surprise & Late Night Fun!

Hey guys! Welcome back to another vlog! 🥰

Today’s vlog is a little extra special because we’re celebrating **Kamakshi’s birthday**! 🎂❤️ From getting ready and heading out for some shopping to Zara & Nykaa shopping, lunch, birthday surprises, gifts, cake cutting and lots of fun family moments — this vlog has a little bit of everything! 🛍️✨

We also had a fun girls’ day out, met some of you guys while shopping, came back home for a sweet birthday surprise and ended the day with a late-night outing. 🥹❤️

Hope you guys enjoy spending the day with us!

Don’t forget to LIKE, COMMENT & SUBSCRIBE** if you enjoyed the vlog! ❤️

Love,
Shy Styles✨
